theory.heading: What Static Site Generation is
theory.body: Static Site Generation describes the methods and patterns used within React Full Stack to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: Static Site Generation is a named, repeatable concept.

theory.heading: Why Static Site Generation matters
theory.body: Without Static Site Generation, systems built with React Full Stack are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Static Site Generation works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Static Site Generation follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of Static Site Generation.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Static Site Generation
theory.body: Static Site Generation offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
